title: Forced self-similar solutions to the stationary Navier--Stokes equations in a half-space
summary: We study axisymmetric self-similar solutions to the stationary Navier--Stokes equations in the half-space with the no-slip boundary condition, driven by an axisymmetric (-3)-homogeneous external force. If the tangential curl of the force on the unit sphere is sufficiently small, we prove the existence of a unique small solution; when the force is swirl-free, the solution is automatically swirl-free and unique.
